notes.title: Gaggi Clicker Release 0.1.0 - Early Access
notes.notes:
Finally, the time has come: Gaggi Clicker is launching today on the Steam Store! :)

Here's a little information about us, the team behind Gaggi Clicker. We are a small group who started chatting on Discord and came up with this idea just for fun. Now, we're on the verge of creating something big. None of us have formal training in game development; we do this in our spare time because we enjoy it. We're trying to implement everything as simply as possible, and there are lots of exciting features to come. We have a whole list of ideas.

We didn't want to include everything right from the start. Instead, we want the community to be involved and help decide what will happen in the future. The game will be completely free, and if you want to be a part of it, feel free to join our Discord. [url=https://discord.gg/gaggiclicker][/url]
